cohort: Singleton pregnant women with GDM attending the Colonial War Memorial Hospital (CWMH) Suva Fiji between June 2013 and May 2014
finding: Older women (≥ 36 years) and those treated with insulin were more likely to have labor induction during childbirth compared with younger women and those on dietary management.
mod_finding: Family history of diabetes was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery, while parity > 5 children and diagnoses of GDM after the first trimester reduced the odds of cesarean delivery.
